$comment: Words and addresses the public pages share, kept here so each is written once. attribution is the footer's line on every page and the About page's licence statement. The About page's gaps are the user's to fill: each is the text [TO DECIDE: ...], and one search for TO DECIDE finds every one. Replace a value with the real text and the page shows it with no marker; src/pages/about.astro states the page is a draft only while any marker is left. The meta block is what Layout.astro writes into each page's head: a specific title, a one-sentence description and the social card tags. A page's title and description say what the page is, name no figure or year and claim nothing causal. The social card image is emitted only once about.site_address is set, because a card image must be an absolute address; the pictures themselves are public/cards/<page>.png, made by scripts/make-social-cards.mjs from these same titles. nav and footer_links are the links every page carries, in order (each id is the page's activeNav); skip_link is the first thing a keyboard visitor reaches. A footer link whose when is answer_pages is drawn only where the build has the brand and model pages (config/answer_pages.json). A meta.pages entry with a generated key is the shared title, description and card of a kind of page the build generates (the value names its entry in config/answer_pages.json): each page of the kind has a title and description of its own and shares that card. sitemap.exclude lists pages that are public but that no search engine should list, such as a page that only sends a visitor on; scripts/sitemap.mjs writes sitemap.xml, and a Sitemap line in robots.txt, only once about.site_address is set.
attribution: Data sources: NZ Transport Agency (NZTA) Motor Vehicle Register and, where a chart says so, NZTA's registrations dashboard, both released under CC BY 4.0. Figures describe registrations recorded by NZTA, not sales.
